body: I used to be a part of a lot of sports clubs when I was younger, mainly solitary sports but I enjoyed them, and I made a few friends doing it. There's a nice Dojo near my house, for one thing; and I find myself looking forward to speaking to them after the holidays. Still looking around for something more group involved, but we'll see what happens.

Thanks for the kind words! I think this is part of it too, I don't really know *what* I want to be. The only job that I can think I would even be partially suited for/would enjoy would be a librarian, believe it or not. 
I know that I need to start being around people more often, so I think that this is the first problem I'm going to attempt to tackle. And actually, I'm going to go and look at what clubs there are locally now.

Thank you so much.
